parties.respondent: High Court of Judicature at Patna & Ors.

summary: Challenge to constitutionality of minimum qualifying marks in viva voce for judicial appointments; violation of Articles 14 and 16; rules in Bihar and Gujarat; All India Judges Association (2002) ruling on Shetty Commission recommendations; standard for qualifying marks; moderation and relaxation in scoring; selection process discrepancies and corrections; impact of procedural irregularities on appointment validity; decision on whether cut-off marks violate precedent.
legal_provisions_cited: Constitution of India, 1950 Art. 14, Art. 16, Art. 32
All India Judges Association vs Union of India, 2002 (4 SCC 247)
final_judgment: Judgment pending (text truncated), but generally addresses constitutional validity of qualifying marks in judicial recruitment; decision to be finalized;
